features.title: First recorded prediction from live prices and memory, resolved by code
criteria: Prices are stored every 5 minutes and survive a process restart
No prediction can be recorded when the asset's latest price is older than 15 minutes
A prediction cannot be recorded without probability, condition, horizon and hypothesis link
A recorded prediction cannot be updated or deleted through the agent's tools
At its horizon, code resolves the prediction from stored prices and computes its Brier score
Resolution appends one evidence row to the linked hypothesis and updates its computed confidence
/statut shows open and resolved predictions in French
Tests make no network or paid inference calls

implementation.note: src/trader: config, schema with append-only triggers, Kraken collector, hypotheses with computed confidence, record_prediction and sonni_memory tools, resolver, French status, /idee; wired into index, loop, prompt, guard, Telegram

features.title: Sonni already knows things: prior hypotheses tested by code on daily history
criteria: Daily candles for followed assets are fetched from Kraken, skip the unfinished day, survive a restart and are refreshed in place
A hypothesis can carry a test rule; invalid rules are refused with a message the model can act on
Code evaluates each rule on stored history and records cases, hits, rate, base rate, z and verdict, append-only
Historical tests rerun only when new days of data arrive, and never change forward confidence
propose_hypothesis tests a rule at once and returns the verdict; origin is prior during the intake, observation after, with a daily limit
Once history is stored, the intake runs on the stronger model, counts an attempt only on a paid turn, and stops at 30 prior hypotheses or 3 attempts
The memory pack and /intuitions show historical verdicts next to forward evidence, in French for the owner
Tests make no network or paid inference calls

implementation.note: src/trader: candles, rules, historical, intake; propose_hypothesis tool; loop and index hooks; pack and status
